qa_pairs.question: What size Torx screws are used for the F clutch on the 4HP-22/4HP-24 transmission?
What transmission types use M8 Torx screws for the F clutch?
qa_pairs.answer: A5S 560Z transmission uses M8 Torx screws.

qa_pairs.question: Which transmission types are specified for the brake band adjusting components?
qa_pairs.answer: A 4 S 270 R/A 4 S 310 R transmissions.

qa_pairs.question: How many different torque values are specified for the F clutch Torx screws across different transmission types?
qa_pairs.answer: Two different torque values: 10 Nm for 4HP-22/4HP-24 transmissions and 23 Nm for A5S 560Z transmission.
